items.title: Accelerate your DynamoDB workloads with DynamoDB caching with Amazon ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey
items.summary: DynamoDB caching with Amazon ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey brings write-through caching to Amazon DynamoDB with sub-millisecond reads and minimal application changes. Serve hot keys from cache, reduce read throttling, and lower read costs while your application keeps calling the DynamoDB API as it does today.
items.creator: Varun Gautam
